hero.text: Forty-one miles of river, from the moor to the sea. Three years ago you couldn't swim in any of it. This is how a town is changing that.

photo.alt: The river Wend running through woodland

give.heading: Give the river a hand.
give.text: £10 buys a volunteer's kit. £50 nets a storm drain for a year. Every gift is spent on the Wend, and we publish where it goes.
